task:
Create a static pod named 'static-nginx' on the control plane node.

Requirements:
  - Image: nginx:1.21
  - Place the manifest at: /etc/kubernetes/manifests/static-nginx.yaml
  - The pod should appear in the default namespace

Static pods are managed directly by the kubelet — no Deployment or ReplicaSet needed.
The kubelet watches the manifests directory and automatically creates/deletes pods.
hints: Generate the manifest: kubectl run static-nginx --image=nginx:1.21 --dry-run=client -o yaml
The kubelet will pick it up within a few seconds — check with kubectl get pods
detailed_hints: The pod name in kubectl will appear as static-nginx-<nodename>
ownerReferences[0].kind will be 'Node' (not ReplicaSet), confirming it's static

validators.command: kubectl get pods --no-headers | grep static-nginx | grep Running
kubectl get pods -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{"\t"}{.spec.containers[0].image}{"\n"}{end}' | grep static-nginx
